records.title: 10-K
records.text: Total revenue increased $1.9 billion in 2021, or 18%, when compared to the previous year due to higher volume, the inclusion of Quality Carriers' results, pricing gains, increases in other revenue and higher fuel recovery.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Chemicals - Decreased due to lower shipments of crude oil and other energy-related commodities, partially offset by higher shipments of core chemicals and waste.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Increases in both domestic and international shipments resulted from strong demand, tight truck capacity, inventory replenishments and growth in rail volumes from east coast ports.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: • Expenses of $6.9 billion increased $707 million or 11% year over year.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: • Operating income of $5.6 billion increased $1.2 billion or 28% year over year.
